flora: Equisetites (Giant Horsetails in dense, vertical stands)
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; segmented stalks with chunky, rounded nodes; branchlets have a soft, 'fuzzy' appearance; emphasis on the rhythmic verticality of the stalks; vibrant green hues to suggest a pocket of moisture.

visual_logic.composition: A mid-range shot of a dense stand of Equisetites growing along a dried-up stream bed. The stalks create a natural screen, with light filtering through the gaps to hit the red soil behind.
visual_logic.ground: Pinkish-grey sandy soil with ripples from ancient water flow, interspersed with fallen green segments of the horsetails.
visual_logic.lighting: SUNNY_EXPOSED_CINEMATIC; warm, direct light creating long, rhythmic shadows across the dry stream bed.
